desc:
DOODLE BALLS ❤️
Draw a line. Let go. Get the two of them together. (romance! physics! mostly physics!)
The less ink you use, the more stars you earn.

🎁 USE CODE: 'RELEASE'

✏️ 130 hand-drawn physics levels (MORE SOON!)
🔥 30 HARD levels — collect 30 stars to unlock them
⭐ 390 stars to collect
🍯 No-draw zones, falling gold, see-saws and one very large boulder
🎨 10 pencils and 10 matching outfits to unlock
🏆 Daily AND all-time global leaderboards
🎡 Daily wheel spins, free group rewards, and a 7-day daily rewards!
Some levels are one line. Others will have you staring at a notebook for ten minutes (I have watched this happen)

Can you get them all together?

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite it if you want more levels!

Inspired by "Love Balls" and the many line-drawing puzzle games like it!
